entry.name: trapezoid~
entry.description: trapezoid~ is a trapezoidal wavetable with signal inputs to change ramp up/down phase position. The default lo/hi points are 0. and 1., but may be changed using the lo/hi messages.

arguments.name: ramp-up
arguments.description: A floating-point value can be used to specify the ramp up value. The argumentsproduce a ramp waveform, andproduces a triangle waveform.

arguments.name: ramp-down
arguments.description: A floating-point value can be used to specify the ramp down value. The argumentsproduce a ramp waveform, andproduces a triangle waveform.

attributes.name: wrapmode
attributes.digest: Wrap Behavior
attributes.description: Controls how the leftmost phase signal input is handled when it is outside the range 0 - 1.

choices.label: Whenis set to 0 (Clip), the phase is clipped to stay between 0 and 1.

Whenis set to 1 (Wrap), phase values above 1 use the decimal part of the number only. For example, an input of 4.3 will be treated as 0.3. Phase values below 0 will have the decimal part of the value subtracted from 1. For example an input of -0.4 will be treated as 0.6.

messages.name: float
messages.description: In left inlet: Any float or signal or an input signal progressing from 0 to 1 is used to scan theobject's wavetable. The output of aor some other audio signal can be used to controlas an oscillator, treating the contents of the wavetable as a repeating waveform.In middle inlet: The ramp up portion of the trapezoidal waveform, specified as a fraction of a cycle between 0 and 1.0. The default is .1.In right inlet: The ramp up portion of the trapezoidal waveform, specified as a fraction of a cycle between 0 and 1.0. The default is 0.9.
